tagline: Six studio albums. Morrison on all of them. That's the whole map.
intro:
**The Doors** only made six studio records with Jim Morrison. This pack is that spine — no *Other Voices*, no endless comps.

Start at the debut. Or *L.A. Woman* if you want the last ride first.
